name: muzikhub
description: MuzikHub — a music-industry ecosystem connecting artists, creators, fans, and professionals.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @muzikhub/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @muzikhub/shared" "npm run dev -w @muzikhub/api" "npm run dev -w @muzikhub/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @muzikhub/shared && npm run dev -w @muzikhub/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @muzikhub/shared && npm run dev -w @muzikhub/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @muzikhub/shared && npm run build -w @muzikhub/api && npm run build -w @muzikhub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @muzikhub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @muzikhub/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
